verdict.rationale: Pilot is a SaaS bookkeeping and accounting service, so offering a public API spec is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence shows no API documentation, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The integration claims describe connections to third-party tools, not a downloadable machine-readable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
